verses.gurmukhi: ਨੈਹਰ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਤਜਿ ਬਿਆਹੇ ਸਸੁਰਾਰ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਨਨ ਕੈ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਬਿਰਦ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: naihar kuTa(n)b taj biaahe sasuraar jai gunan kai kulaa badhoo biradh kahaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a girl leaves her parent's house after getting married and earns a respectable name for herself and her husband's family by virtue of her good traits;

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਅਉ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੇਸੁਰਿ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran patibrat aau gur jan sevaa bhai gireh mai girahesur sujas pragaTaaviee ||

en.bdb: Earns the honourable title of all in all and revered one, by devotedly serving her elders and remaining loyal and faithful to her partner;

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹ ਗਾਮਿਨੀ ਹੁਇ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਊਚ ਪਦ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)t kaal jai pria sa(n)g seh gaaminee hui lok paralok bikhai uooch padh paaviee ||

en.bdb: Departs from this world as an honourable companion of her husband and earns name for herself here and in world hereafter;

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਧੰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥੧੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag bhai bhai nirabaahu karai dha(n)n gursikh aadh a(n)t Thahiraaviee ||119||

en.bdb: So is a Sikh of Guru worthy of praise and adulations from beginning to end who treads the path of the Guru, lives life in the reverential fear of the Lord. (119)
